scope: Single-letter forced choice over every source-guideline action plus insufficient evidence. No-rule original still sees all action options. Free-text generation is not evaluated.

reference_isolation.oracle_exception: Correct original guideline rule selected offline only after ordinary inference; no gt answer text/path labels in inference or gates

metric_definitions.probability: Full-vocabulary probability of the exact single-letter token. Option-normalized probability is separately named.
metric_definitions.gold_minus_prior: logP(gold)-logP(original selected option), zero if original is correct; original-incorrect subset reported separately.
metric_definitions.head_effect: Correct-minus-fixed-incorrect margin: single-head edit minus prompt-only; retained-head effect is prompt-only minus head ablation. Positive/zero/negative counts are empirical; no arbitrary stability threshold.
metric_definitions.condition_scope: Known reference-path signed condition IDs, deduplicated per case; off-path nodes excluded; guided_decision free text receives no automatic semantic accuracy label.

retrieval.interpretation: Small complete guidelines retain every leaf; recall gain does not demonstrate improved ranking on large guidelines.

repair_progress.remaining_issue: Evidence verification still changes 6 initially correct signed conditions to unknown; 9 cases have unknown gold-rule applicability.

free_generation.offline_review: Both complete TRIAGE decisions match their official reference rule actions; raw full-guideline output also selects them. No independent attention decision correction in these two cases.
